name: Outfoxed!
description:
Mrs. Plumpert's prized pot pie has gone missing, and now it's a chicken chase to crack the case! In Outfoxed, you move around the board to gather clues, then use the special evidence scanner to rule out suspects. You have to work together quickly because the guilty fox is high-tailing it towards the exit! Will you halt the hungry hooligan before it flies the coop — or will you be outfoxed?

Outfoxed is a simplified, cooperative version of Clue.  Players roll dice to move around the board or investigate suspects.  If they do not roll the correct amount, the fox moves closer to escaping. Plyers use the evidence scanner to find out information (such as color of sirt, or wearing a hat) to help them eliminate the 16 suspect cards lining the board.

There are three ways of ending the game: Name the thief, eliminate all but one suspect and match it to the Thief card in the decoder, or the fox reaches the foxhole space on the game board, escapes, and the players lose the game.
